title: Jerk Jamaican Feta Tagine
description: A buttery, crumbly, vegan-friendly Jamaican dish featuring cubed feta cheese, cooked in a copper mug, perfect for curing hangovers. This tagine is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the jerk seasoning, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
In a copper mug, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and scotch bonnet pepper to the mug and saute until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cubed feta cheese to the mug and stir to combine with the vegetables and oil.
Sprinkle the jerk seasoning mixture over the top of the feta cheese.
Transfer the mug to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the mug from the oven and stir in the chopped tomato.
Return the mug to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the mug from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
